caseDescription: Equivalent scenario to locale-id-notification.json: the same WhatsApp-generated attachment placeholder string rendered in an English device/app UI locale.
notes: Pairs with locale-id-notification.json using the same shortcutId/conversationTitle to represent literally the same chat scenario.
